name: Saeki Ayaka
source:
In order to save money for studying abroad, she started compensated dating at the recommendation of a friend. She is a pure, meek girl who isn't self assertive. Contrary to her prim and proper appearance, she has quite a voluptuous body and is actually a bit of a lewd girl herself, but she hasn't realized it quite yet. 

"Is it really fine for me to earn money just by chatting and having dinner with you?"

[Translated from the [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/papakatsu/]official website[/url]]
